create_summary_writer_context: create a context manager that pushes a SummaryWriter onto the stack for scoped tensorboard logging
use_summary_writer_context_meta: use the metaclass to proxy any SummaryWriter method call through the current context stack
add_histogram_values: add a histogram of values to the current SummaryWriter with automatic global step tracking
add_custom_scalars_multilinechart: add a multiline chart with tags to a custom scalar category and title for tensorboard
increase_global_step: increase the global step counter used by SummaryWriterContext for all logged scalar values
